title: [29.x][InterCompany][SII] Setup and telemetry enhancements
summary: Backport to 29.x of setup and telemetry enhancements for the Cross Intercompany connector and its setup pages and for the Spanish SII Setup table, taken from #11016. Automated intercompany tests were added.
key_points: Backports only the intercompany and SII parts of #11016 to releases/29.x
CrossIntercompany Connector codeunit gets most of the changes, described as setup and telemetry enhancements
Cross Intercompany partner and modify setup pages are adjusted
SII Setup table is changed and the SII endpoint URL validation tests are updated
New ERM intercompany tests in the W1 and RU layers
quote: Setup and telemetry enhancements for InterCompany and SII
